text: {"name": "mac_irq_check", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Polls a MAC IRQ/timestamp status word, updates the stored low count and bit-31 flag when the value lies within a 159-count window, and returns the pending low value or zero if no status change is observed.", "subsystem": "mac", "var_renames": {"v0": "raw_status", "result": "low_status", "v2": "status_flag", "v3": "updated_status"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 0, "meaning": "word used as the new low field when updating the status"}, {"offset": 4, "meaning": "reference counter used in the 159-count window comparison"}, {"offset": 8, "meaning": "raw status word; bit 31 carries a flag, low 31 bits hold the event/timestamp value"}]}
